description: The latest signed observation of one domain: who runs its nameservers, mail, and CDN; certificate issuer and expiry; HTTPS reachability; per-record-type counts; and the Ed25519 receipt pointer. Keyless calls get this reduced preview, throttled to 1 request per 15 seconds per IP under a shared daily ceiling. Connect with a DomainDrift API key in an Authorization: Bearer header to get the complete signed record instead, metered against your account like any API request.
name: lookup_domain
title: Look up one domain
